reason: B anticipates what I would push back on: it admits some of the loss is made back on brand-name drugs, and it recognises that the PBM sets the rates while the plan sets the contract terms, so it reads as credible rather than as the annual complaint. A overreaches by saying every pharmacy still open is losing money and that a fifth of their work is done at a loss, which goes beyond an average on 20 generics and makes me discount the rest.
